phases.name: Year 1
phases.subtitle: Explore
phases.description: Economic & Legal Foundations — Build economic reasoning and explore the intersection of law and economics.

milestones.label: Complete CliftonStrengths assessment and pre-law career mapping
milestones.description: Complete the Gallup CliftonStrengths assessment and connect signature themes to law and economics career pathways including regulatory policy, antitrust law, legal consulting, and government service.

milestones.label: Master principles of microeconomics
milestones.description: Study consumer behavior, market structures, pricing theory, and resource allocation. Build the economic reasoning skills foundational to law and economics analysis.

milestones.label: Master principles of macroeconomics
milestones.description: Examine national income, monetary and fiscal policy, and how government economic regulation affects markets. Focus on the policy frameworks that shape legal and regulatory environments.

milestones.label: Join Pre-Law Society or Economics Club
milestones.description: Join NC A&T's Pre-Law Society or Economics Club. Attend mock trial events, legal career panels, and constitutional law discussions to build a pre-law network.

milestones.label: Analyze constitutional economics and property rights
milestones.description: Explore how constitutional frameworks, property rights systems, and legal institutions shape economic outcomes across nations. Students compare U.S. and international legal-economic systems.

phases.name: Year 2
phases.subtitle: Engage
phases.description: Intermediate Economics & Legal Reasoning — Integrate economic theory with business law and analytical writing.

milestones.label: Complete intermediate microeconomic theory
milestones.description: Advanced consumer and producer theory, externalities, public goods, and market failures that form the economic basis for legal regulation and antitrust policy.

milestones.label: Study business law and legal environment
milestones.description: Introduction to the American legal system, contracts, torts, intellectual property, and constitutional law as applied to business. Students brief cases and develop legal reasoning skills.

milestones.label: Participate in moot court or mock trial competition
milestones.description: Compete in a moot court or mock trial event, developing oral advocacy, legal argumentation, and courtroom presence. Connect with pre-law advisors and law school representatives.

milestones.label: Analyze international trade law and regulation
milestones.description: Examine the economic rationale for trade agreements, tariffs, and WTO dispute resolution. Students analyze how international trade law shapes domestic economic policy.

phases.name: Year 3
phases.subtitle: Develop
phases.description: Law & Economics Specialization — Master quantitative legal analysis, LSAT preparation, and professional experience.

milestones.label: Master econometrics for legal and policy analysis
milestones.description: Regression analysis and causal inference methods applied to legal and regulatory questions. Students analyze discrimination cases, regulatory impact assessments, and damages estimation.

milestones.label: Study law and economics theory
milestones.description: Economic analysis of legal rules including property law, tort liability, criminal law, and contract enforcement. Students apply the Coase Theorem and efficiency analysis to evaluate legal institutions.

milestones.label: Secure and engage with a legal industry mentor
milestones.description: Establish a mentorship with a practicing attorney, legal economist, or policy analyst. Monthly meetings focus on law school admissions, career pathways, and professional development.

milestones.label: Complete summer pre-law internship
milestones.description: Secure an internship at a law firm, government agency, regulatory body, or public interest organization. Apply economic analysis to legal questions in a professional setting.

milestones.label: Analyze antitrust and competition policy
milestones.description: Study market power, merger analysis, price-fixing, and antitrust enforcement using economic theory and empirical methods. Analyze landmark antitrust cases and their implications for competition policy.

phases.name: Year 4
phases.subtitle: Launch
phases.description: Career Placement & Capstone — LSAT preparation, capstone research, and law school or career launch.

milestones.label: Execute capstone law and economics research project
milestones.description: Complete a comprehensive research paper applying economic analysis to a legal or regulatory question. Present findings to faculty and legal professionals. Strong projects support law school applications.

milestones.label: Complete LSAT preparation and law school applications
milestones.description: Intensive LSAT preparation including practice exams, logical reasoning workshops, and analytical writing practice. Submit law school applications with personal statements and faculty recommendations.

milestones.label: Serve as peer mentor and pre-law advisor
milestones.description: Mentor underclassmen interested in law and economics, sharing pre-law preparation insights and internship strategies. Model the integration of economic analysis and legal reasoning.

milestones.label: Study regulatory economics and public policy
milestones.description: Evaluate government regulatory programs using economic frameworks including cost-benefit analysis, regulatory impact analysis, and program evaluation. Write policy briefs on current regulatory debates.

milestones.label: Complete exit assessment and career activation
milestones.description: Complete the CoBE Economics Exit Assessment and finalize career activation documenting law school acceptances, job offers, or fellowship placements.
